summary: Risk-off overnight: a hot October CPI has traders betting on a December Fed hike, pushing the 10-year yield back above 5% and the dollar to a 19-month high. Stocks slipped (S&P -0.4%, Nasdaq -0.6%) after Nvidia said CEO Jensen Huang resigned; gold fell ~3% and USD/JPY hit 160, raising Japan intervention risk.
events_next_24h: Sat 2:00am USD UMich consumer sentiment (prelim Nov)
tier1_next_14d: FOMC minutes (27-28 Oct meeting) · Thu, 19 Nov, 6:00am
US PCE and personal income (Oct) + Q3 GDP 2nd estimate · Thu, 26 Nov, 12:30am

ES.why: Hot CPI and Fed hike bets lifted the 10-year above 5% and the S&P closed lower; fund positioning is neutral so no squeeze fuel either way.
ES.risk: A soft PPI print that cools hike bets.

NQ.why: Higher yields hit growth stocks and Nvidia's CEO exit hit AI leaders; funds are crowded long (98th pct), so there is room to unwind.
NQ.risk: Strong AI earnings (Cisco/AMAT) or a soft PPI sparking a dip-buy.

YM.why: Dow erased early gains into the close as rate-hike odds rose; a lean only, value names hold up better than tech.

RTY.why: Small caps are the most rate-sensitive and the 10-year back above 5% plus hike talk works against them; lean only.
RTY.risk: A sharp fall in yields on soft data.

NKD.why: Weak yen helps exporters but US tech/AI weakness and yen intervention risk at 160 pull the other way; funds neutral (46th pct).
NKD.risk: Tokyo intervening (yen spike) would hit NKD; a quiet yen with tech rebound lifts it.

6E.why: The dollar hit a 19-month high on Fed hike bets after hot CPI; euro has no offsetting news.
6E.risk: Soft US PPI cooling the dollar.

6J.why: Rate gap favours a weaker yen, but USD/JPY at 160 brings Japan intervention warnings and BOJ December hike odds are rising; funds lean long (77th).
6J.risk: Actual intervention would send 6J sharply higher.

6B.why: Broad dollar strength after hot US inflation weighs on sterling; lean only, no UK catalyst found.
6B.risk: Dollar reversal on soft US data.

6A.why: Risk-off tone and a 19-month dollar high weigh on the risk-sensitive Aussie; lean only.
6A.risk: Risk appetite returning and the dollar easing.

ZN.why: Hot CPI and a possible December Fed hike pushed the 10-year yield back above 5%, which means lower bond prices.
ZN.risk: A soft PPI print or risk-off flight to safety into bonds.

GC.why: Gold fell ~3% as the dollar and real yields jumped on Fed hike bets; funds lean short (21st pct) but are not yet crowded.
GC.risk: Dollar reversal or a geopolitical shock driving safe-haven buying.

CL.why: Reports conflict on direction (oil gains vs Ukraine peace hopes) and funds are crowded short (10th pct), so downside fuel is thin.
CL.risk: Peace-deal headlines (down) or a short squeeze (up).
